tasks.short: Present actual research findings to clients or research meetings.

steps.what: Prepare presentation pages from actual checked research findings and existing verified figures
inputs: actual research findings and verified figures produced by the research team

steps.what: Check presentation claims, figure labels, limitations and suitability for the actual audience
inputs: actual research findings and verified figures produced by the research team

steps.what: Conduct the actual presentation of research findings for clients or research meetings
Discuss actual audience questions and capture assigned research follow-up
outputs: actual discussion facts and assigned actions captured by psychologist

steps.what: Write actual assigned presentation follow-up in the internal research record
inputs: actual discussion facts and assigned actions captured by psychologist

tasks.design: Use native slide styles and reusable verified figure placements for actual presentation preparation. Remove only repeated page assembly; retain claim checking, actual delivery, audience discussion, fresh capture and assigned written follow-up, with no automatic client send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated slide arrangement can sit around actual communication of research findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native presentation styles reuse page layout without generating findings.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining limitations and responding to the real audience remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that the audience has interpreted an association as a causal claim.
tasks.altitude: Communicate checked research rather than repeat slide layout.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native presentation styles reduce repeated page layout but do not communicate or interpret research for an actual audience.

assumptions: Shares15/10/60/10/5 are provisional, not measured. s1 removes3 repeated page-assembly points, retaining12 for actual selection and wording. Research findings and figures are existing verified team outputs, not newly free analysis.

s4 counts fresh capture and s5 only actual assigned follow-up; remove/reweight if none is owned. Ordinary saves remain retained and ungated. No generated audience response, synthetic research result or automatic public release is proposed.
unknowns: Which actual slide layouts recur and which follow-up does the presenter own?
research_questions: Observe layout operations separately from explaining research limitations.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 layout points less0.5 upkeep. Low: an unfamiliar client audience needs new explanatory graphics and structure, leaving0.8 reusable page-heading points removable, less0.5 upkeep. Claim check10, delivery60, discussion10 and written follow-up5 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coach actual executives and managers on leadership and performance.

steps.what: Understand the actual executive's goals, leadership context and boundaries of the coaching engagement
Coach through actual reflection, practice and feedback and capture agreed actions
outputs: psychologist-captured coaching facts and actual agreed actions

steps.what: Write the actual confidential coaching note from psychologist-captured facts and actions
inputs: psychologist-captured coaching facts and actual agreed actions

loop.purpose: Restate actual coaching notes without assessing the executive
loop.input: psychologist-captured facts and actual agreed actions
loop.output: proposed internal note preserving uncertainty and confidentiality boundaries
loop.check: Psychologist checks every factual implication, agreement, omission and attribution against notes; no personality inference or performance rating is accepted
loop.stop: Unapproved confidential-data route, missing notes or two failed revisions returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native coaching-note headings handle fixed structure; only variable factual restatement uses a bounded prose loop

steps.what: Check complete coaching meaning and save the ordinary internal confidential note
inputs: psychologist-captured coaching facts and actual agreed actions

tasks.design: Keep the actual coaching relationship and all leadership or performance judgement with the psychologist. Use a bounded draft only to restate actual captured coaching facts for the assigned internal note, with a complete meaning/confidentiality check and ungated ordinary save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Restating actual captured actions can repeat limited confidential-note writing work.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded restatement draft can support documentation without evaluating the executive.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, challenge and appropriate coaching feedback remain relational.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize what the executive is avoiding without turning that observation into a machine rating.
tasks.altitude: Check faithful notes while remaining the actual coach.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a bounded model can restate supplied coaching facts, but meaning and confidentiality require the psychologist's check.

assumptions: Shares20/60/15/5 are provisional, not measured. s2 counts actual fresh capture. s3 removes2.25 restatement points only; substantive writing/revision remains12.75, final check5 remains full. Apply only to an actual assigned note and approved confidential-data route; otherwise write manually.
No transcript, executive profile, automated performance evaluation, employment recommendation or employer report is generated. Ordinary internal note save remains retained and ungated.
unknowns: Does the actual coaching agreement permit the approved documentation route?
research_questions: Compare proposed notes for new evaluative implications or lost confidentiality boundaries.

incremental.description: Maintain confidential-note constraints and inspect recurring meaning failures.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2.25 restatement points less0.6 upkeep, rounded down to1.6. Low: sensitive leadership conflict needs manual nuanced wording, leaving0.7 straightforward agreed-action restatement points removable, less0.6 upkeep. Context20, actual coaching60 and full check5 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct individual assessments, interpret measures and give selection, placement or promotion feedback.

steps.what: Conduct the actual individual assessment and capture authentic responses under the agreed protocol
Verify protocol adherence, completeness and applicability of the selected norm tables
inputs: actual authorized scoring keys and norm tables maintained by test publisher
outputs: verified scorable responses and psychologist-selected scoring rules

steps.what: Calculate fixed assessment totals and norm-table lookups using the verified scoring rules
inputs: verified scorable responses and psychologist-selected scoring rules
outputs: proposed exact scores with response and norm-table lineage

steps.what: Check scores and interpret measures, validity limits and individual assessment implications
inputs: proposed exact scores with response and norm-table lineage
verified scorable responses and psychologist-selected scoring rules
outputs: human assessment interpretation and explicit limitations

steps.what: Provide actual individual assessment feedback and capture clarifications
inputs: human assessment interpretation and explicit limitations
outputs: actual feedback and clarifications captured by psychologist

steps.what: Write the actual checked assessment and feedback record in the restricted internal file
inputs: human assessment interpretation and explicit limitations
actual feedback and clarifications captured by psychologist

tasks.design: Use exact publisher-authorized scoring rules and norm-table lookups for actual manual arithmetic only. Retain assessment administration, authentic response capture, protocol/norm applicability, complete score interpretation, individual feedback and authored records; no model ranks people or decides selection, placement or promotion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed scoring arithmetic and table lookups may be performed manually after actual assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Authorized deterministic scoring can trace totals to responses and selected norms.
tasks.still_hard: Validity, suitability and implications for the actual person remain professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a mechanically correct score is invalid or misleading in context.
tasks.altitude: Check exact scores and interpret people in context rather than calculate totals manually.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact test arithmetic and authorized norm-table lookups are deterministic, while interpretation and employment implications remain professional judgement.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual publisher-authorized scoring application. Shares30/10/20/25/10/5 are provisional, not measured. s3 applies only to actual manual scoring; existing scoring software receives no credit. Authentic responses are captured in s1 and verified in s2, not freely inferred.

The psychologist selects applicable norms and checks score lineage and validity. No new inference model, worker ranking, automatic employment decision or employer-report send is proposed. Actual external assessment reports or HR decisions require separately mapped final-version gates; ordinary internal record save remains ungated.
unknowns: Which measures are actually manually scored and licensed for this exact scoring route?
research_questions: Validate exact totals and norm lookups against publisher examples and actual protocol exceptions.

incremental.description: Maintain authorized scoring versions and validation examples when norms change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 actual arithmetic/lookup points less1.2 upkeep. Low: mixed measures and inapplicable norm groups need manual scoring for most responses, leaving5 points of compatible authorized scoring removable, less1.2 upkeep. Administration30, protocol check10, interpretation25, actual feedback10 and record5 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train clients to administer actual HR testing, selection and performance-management functions.

steps.what: Understand actual client HR processes, learner responsibilities and training needs
inputs: actual testing, selection or performance-management processes

steps.what: Prepare actual HR administration demonstrations and exercises using verified training-page templates
inputs: verified training examples maintained by psychologist

steps.what: Train actual clients through demonstrations, practice, questions and checks of understanding
outputs: actual training observations and follow-up captured by psychologist

steps.what: Write actual assigned training completion and follow-up notes after the session
inputs: actual training observations and follow-up captured by psychologist

tasks.design: Reuse native training-page layouts and verified demonstration structures for actual client HR instruction. Retain needs analysis, process-specific exercise content, actual teaching, fresh observation capture and actual post-session notes; no employee assessment or selection process is executed by software here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated exercise-page setup can recur around actual HR training.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates reuse verified presentation structures.
tasks.still_hard: Learners must understand actual HR responsibilities and exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a learner applying a technically correct step to an inappropriate personnel situation.
tasks.altitude: Teach responsible actual HR administration rather than rebuild exercise pages.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native exercise-page templates reduce repeated training preparation without delivering instruction or making personnel decisions.

assumptions: Shares15/20/55/10 are provisional, not measured. s2 removes5 repeated page/demo setup points, retaining15 for actual client-process content and verification. Use only genuinely maintained examples and count upkeep below.

s3 captures actual session observations; s4 records only actual assigned completion/follow-up after the session. Remove/reweight if no written record is owned. No free transcript, inferred attendance, worker score or automatic client report is proposed; ordinary internal saves remain ungated.
unknowns: Which actual client-process exercise layouts can be reused?
research_questions: Observe repeated preparation separately from actual process-specific teaching content.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 repeated preparation points less0.6 upkeep. Low: a client with unfamiliar selection procedures needs new exercises, leaving1.5 stable page-layout points removable, less0.6 upkeep. Needs15, actual training55 and post-session record10 remain.
